fields.name: sign
fields.description: Zodiac sign name, case-insensitive (e.g., pisces, Pisces, PISCES all work). Valid: aries, taurus, gemini, cancer, leo, virgo, libra, scorpio, sagittarius, capricorn, aquarius, pisces.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Maximum items to return per page. Range: 1-30, default 20.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Number of items to skip for pagination. Default 0.
